manufacturing_notes: Document references specific technical sheets (TAB series) for detailed manufacturing standards
Family codes (66xxx series) organize components by type: gears, shafts, pins, carriers, nuts
training_guidance: When modeling shafts, reference TAB 004 for oil seal seats, TAB 005 for bearing seats, and TAB 009 for surface finish on dynamic surfaces
For spline and gear features, consult TAB 007 for mesh marking grooves and TAB 011 for pressure angle standards (20°)
Keyway geometry must follow TAB 014 standards
Thread features should reference TAB 008 for ring nut threads and TAB 017 for ISO triangular profile threads

Component family codes 66xxx series indicate: 66300-A (piston shafts), 66301-B (solar/satellite spline shafts), 66311 (hollow shafts), 66345-A (planetary pins), 66410-A (ring gears), 66420 (planetary gears), 66430 (sun gears), 66500 (gears with bore), 66555 (planet carriers), 66600 (ring nuts)
For assembly drawings, follow TAB 098 conventions; for drawing lists and revisions, follow TAB 099
summary: This is a comprehensive index page (MTQ-001, page 1/3) from the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook listing all technical sheets (TAB series) and component family codes. It provides navigation to detailed standards covering seating surfaces, threads, splines, gears, keyways, surface finishes, and drawing conventions. The index organizes content both by manufacturing feature type (TAB 001-099) and by component family codes (66xxx series) for shafts, gears, pins, carriers, and nuts.
